content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Review: ERP System Integration for North American Pharmaceutical Operations
agenda_items: Assess regulatory compliance implications for data synchronization in FDA-regulated environments
Discuss budget allocation for Phase 2 expansion to remaining facilities
key_decisions: Established cross-functional steering committee led by VP of Operations and Chief Information Officer
Approved expansion of integration pilot to five additional manufacturing sites pending successful validation at current locations
Mandated implementation of enhanced audit trail capabilities to meet 21 CFR Part 11 compliance requirements
action_items: Kwame Osei to coordinate with Quality Assurance on validation protocol for integrated systems by end of next month
Tatiana Volkov to develop comprehensive change management plan for end-user training across all sites within 6 weeks
